What I Fix

The To-Do List I Can Take Off Your Hands

Most of the repairs I do are the kind that pile up — individually not worth calling a big contractor, but together they're a real headache. I handle them all, one visit if I can.

🏠

Indoor Jobs

  • Drywall repair & patching
  • Leaky faucets & running toilets
  • Door & window adjustments
  • Light fixtures & ceiling fans
  • Tile & grout repair
  • Cabinet doors & hardware
  • Shelf & furniture assembly
  • Caulking & weatherstripping
  • Attic access & pull-down stairs
  • Bathroom & kitchen caulk
🌿

Outdoor Jobs

  • Deck & fence repair
  • Pressure washing
  • Gutter cleaning & repair
  • Exterior caulking & painting touch-ups
  • Screen door & window screen repair
  • Gate & latch fixes
  • Wood rot repair
  • Minor concrete & masonry
  • Mailbox & address number install
  • Outdoor lighting & fixtures

Don't see your job on the list?

The list is a sample, not the limit. Give me a call — if it's something I can do right, I'll take it. If it's not in my wheelhouse, I'll tell you that too.
